description:
LEVELS OF ASSISTANCE AND AUTONOMY Five power levels to manage assistance in the best way guaranteeing exceptional performance to tackle any type of route. MOTOR Limitless power with OLI SPORT PLUS which develops a torque of 85 Nm. This version expresses all the possible power for those who do not want to set limits. The assistance amazes from the first pedal stroke and adapts perfectly to any route, thus allowing the user to concentrate on riding, offering unimaginable sensations. BATTERY Infinity is the 900 Wh battery that ensures unprecedented autonomy. Thanks to the latest generation 21700 cells, it is possible to achieve a greater capacity without increasing the overall space. This allows for the size and weight of a normal battery that integrates perfectly with the frame, but with greater available energy. Infinity allows you to reach a real autonomy of up to 300 km, ensuring long-lasting performance and fun.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES CROSS OVER EVO is part of the line of e-bikes equipped with a 900 Wh INFINITY battery and super autonomy increased up to 300 km. This mileage, never achieved before, is supported by the powerful 250W OLI engine, designed with an extremely sensitive latest-generation hi-tech effort sensor, which is activated by simply pressing the pedal regardless of rotation. The intelligent assistance is activated based on the pressure exerted on the pedal, so that the progressive support of the engine automatically adapts to the driving situation. The 85 Nm torque allows you to develop enough power to tackle any type of route naturally. IDEAL FOR CROSS OVER EVO combines the capabilities of a mountain bike with the versatility of a city bike. From this union comes a hybrid bike capable of tackling dirt and off-road trails, but also urban and city routes in complete comfort. The trekking equipment includes a series of accessories ready for adventure: mudguards, luggage rack and lighting system. There is also provision for attaching the basket to the steering tube. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you are looking for a great trekking bike, you are attracted by details and innovations. A powerful and versatile pedal-assisted bike, to tackle long adventure rides. Comfortable and reliable, CROSS OVER EVO will be able to take you on all your excursions, where the only thing that will make you lose your breath will be the view.
